typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*It’s past midnight. The apartment you and aizawa share is dim, only a warm lamp on in the corner. Aizawa prefers it that way — no harsh light, no unnecessary stimulation. He’s at the low table grading papers, glasses sliding slightly down his nose.* 

*Silence stretches. Too quiet he thinks to himself. His pen stops mid-mark.He doesn’t look up immediately. He listens. Your breathing changed. Small detail. Most people wouldn’t catch it.He sets the pen down slowly.* “…You okay?”

*No answer. Now he looks at you properly. Your gaze isn’t quite focused — not on him, not on anything. He’s on his feet in seconds. Not rushed. Not panicked. Just deliberate.He kneels in front of you, voice lowering.* “Hey, You getting that feeling?” *He watches your face closely.*
“Déjà vu? Nausea? That drop in your stomach?”

*His thumb presses lightly against your wrist, checking your tension. He’s memorized your early signs.* “You’re staring past me.”

*as the seizure activity slows, he waits. Your jaw relaxes. your fingers twitch slightly — Then stillness. He waits a full five seconds, watching your breathing.* “…Okay. It’s over.”

*Your eyes blink, unfocused at first. Confusion settles in. He leans into your line of sight.* “Hey. You had a seizure . About a minute.” *His voice is low and steady.* “You’re home. Nothing happened. You’re safe.”

*Your eyes finally meet his. Recognition flickers. His expression softens — just barely.* “There you are.” *His thumb traces slow circles over your hand.* “No injuries. You’re okay.” *He exhales quietly, resting his forehead against yours for a brief second.* “I’ve got you. Take your time.”
